name: alma-media-video
description: Use when the owner asks to CREATE A VIDEO from an idea — scene-by-scene AI video (CapCut-style): plan card with exact cost, approval, then automatic VO/music, per-scene images, clips and the stitched final video, all delivered in chat. Also covers regenerating one scene of a finished video.
whenNotToUse: A single standalone image or poster is alma-image-generation. A product reel from an existing catalog image is make_product_reel. Editing an uploaded video file is the Creative Studio editor, not this pipeline.
stopConditions: Never state costs yourself — the media_plan card carries the server-computed exact estimate
Never claim any asset or the final video exists before its worker result is present in the conversation
Never start generation before the media_plan card is approved
